problems: british-africa is a Cliopatria composite: 32 of 33 shapes carry corrections (Egypt as client/protectorate, Mahdist Sudan 1885-1889, Asian lands 1917-1946, occupied territories). It overlaps dossiers of many other groups (british-cape-colony, colony-of-natal, orange-river-colony, transvaal-colony, basutoland, british-bechuanaland, sierra-leone-colony-and-protectorate, swaziland, mahdist-state, lozi-kingdom, ndebele-kingdom, sultanate-of-darfur, belgian-congo, kingdom-of-egypt, south-africa): rendering must not draw both; see notes.

british-africa cites 15 distinct pages against a budget of 14: the Lado Enclave page was opened for belgian-congo and reused; belgian-congo reuses no more than its budget of 5 (East African campaign (World War I) and Tanganyika Territory are also cited by british-africa).
belgian-congo runs 1908-11 to 1962-07 (Cliopatria's row ends 1962 with Ruanda-Urundi only); the 1890-1907 shapes are marked wrong because they belong to congo-free-state.
british-africa has no capital (empty list) because it is a composite; the 1960 dissolve is a Cliopatria relabelling (british-east-africa 1961).
